Compare protein-altering mutations in one gene across 1–32 curated cBioPortal studies in one portal

gf_cbioportal_cross_study_mutations.Rd

Compare protein-altering mutations in one gene across 1–32 curated cBioPortal studies in one portal. Uses gene-assayed sample denominators and complete mutation/fetch pagination. Choose molecular_profile_id when a study has several mutation profiles. Study/sample observations are separate, not pooled unique patients; missing profiles and empty assay cohorts remain unavailable. On request (pdf, html, csv; each off by default), writes a multipart branded PDF, matching HTML and full CSV when an output directory is configured. Latency: 10–180 s.

Usage

gf_cbioportal_cross_study_mutations(
    session,
    `gene`,
    `studies`,
    `csv` = NULL,
    `generated_at` = NULL,
    `html` = NULL,
    `pdf` = NULL,
    `portal` = NULL,
    progress_callback = NULL
)

Arguments

session

A GeneFox session from gf_session.

gene

(string) HGNC gene symbol, e.g. CLDN18. Upper-cased, as the app does.

studies

(array)

csv

(boolean, optional; default false) Also write all selected study results, unavailable reasons, counts, source and methods. NULL omits it.

generated_at

(string, optional) ISO 8601 report timestamp with time zone; omitted uses the current time. NULL omits it.

html

(boolean, optional; default false) Also write the matching self-contained branded HTML report. NULL omits it.

pdf

(boolean, optional; default false) Also write one complete multipart branded PDF. NULL omits it.

portal

(string, optional; one of "public", "ccdi", "pedcbioportal") public (cBioPortal), ccdi (CCDI cBioPortal, pediatric) or pedcbioportal (refused: it needs a personal data-access token, which this server never takes). NULL omits it.

progress_callback

Optional function receiving runtime progress events; NULL disables progress.

Value

A gf_result holding the engine payload, provenance and owned figures for the cbioportal_cross_study_mutations tool. The runtime validates every argument and refuses tools absent from its gf_tools() list. Result contract: https://genefox.app/schemas/v1/cbioportal-cross-study-mutations-result-v1.schema.json.
